name: joinquant-skill
title_zh: 聚宽API长在代码里，写完直接能跑的回测生成器
tagline_zh: 不用翻294KB官方文档，14类API按需展开。五套生产级模板打底，单股到ETF期货策略，写完不报错直接上聚宽跑。
tagline_en: Skip 294KB of docs—14 API categories unfold as you type. 5 prod-grade templates from single-stock to futures.
desc_en: Generate accurate, runnable quantitative strategy code for the JoinQuant (聚宽) platform. Use this skill when the user asks to write a stock/ETF/futures backtest, paper-trading, or live-trading strategy on JoinQuant — the skill provides progressive-disclosure access to the complete JoinQuant API knowledge base (14 categories, 294KB official docs), 5 production-ready strategy templates (single-stock
why_zh: 渐进式披露：你写到哪，相关API才亮到哪。模板不是玩具，是能扛实盘的结构。报错率比手搓低一个量级。
why_en: Progressive disclosure: APIs surface only when you need them. Templates are battle-tested for live trading, not demos. Error.
limit_zh: 只认聚宽平台语法，生成的代码不能直接搬到其他量化平台（如米筐、vnpy）。不负责选股逻辑的收益表现。
limit_en: JoinQuant syntax only—won't port to RiceQuant/vnpy. Does not optimize stock-picking logic; if your strategy loses money, that's on the strategy, not.
title_en: JoinQuant backtest code that runs, with API built in
